simplifiedNote: Exploration content (D-012, extended in the 2026-11-15 merge): the west glacier route (ice clusters, frozen wrecks, the cargo lander and the Deep Space 2 probe) and the east lava-plain route (dig sites, the sealed skylight, the lava-tube sub-map). Positions, minutes, hit counts, points and rewards are game values for pacing, not measurements. The lava tube, the cargo lander and the SCOUT-1 rover are fictional: known Mars skylights/possible caves are on Arsia Mons (Tharsis), not at the landing sites in this game.

cave.scaleNote: The tube uses the surface scale (gameplay.metersPerPixel), so walking speed, jumping and the metres-per-game-minute rule are identical inside and outside.
cave.roomSpanNote: Fictional chamber width (game value). Real Arsia Mons skylight openings are about 100-225 m across.

skylight.note: Mars Odyssey THEMIS: from day to night the Arsia Mons skylight's temperature changes only about one third as much as the surrounding surface. Game model (simplified): deep reading = diurnal mean + (current surface - mean) x this fraction.

cave.vibrationNote: Synthetic, relative amplitudes (no unit) for an interpretation exercise: one point rings differently, which needs more data; it never proves the chamber is safe.

scout.note: SCOUT-1 (TR: IZCI-1) is a fictional rover, not one of the real missions (K3 Medine prototype). Its five parts tell why a rover sent into a cave fails: rock blocks the radio link and no sunlight reaches the solar panel.

dig.note: Buried wrecks and the sealed skylight. A site with "case" sits at that case's distanceM; mounds without a reward are decoys that teach the suit scanner (it only reacts near something real). Every hit costs game minutes, so suit O2, battery and cold keep running while digging.

westFinds.note: Reports for the fictional cargo lander (its three parts) and the Deep Space 2 probe, filed on entering the habitat like the ice relics.

fieldCam.note: FIELD CAM photo minigame (K3 Medine): turn the focus ring until the subject is sharp, hold it, then shoot. Game values.
